title: Vertiv Delivers Strong Third Quarter Operating Performance
summary: Net sales growth of 8.5% from last years third quarter fueled by continued strong demand from cloud and colocation market segments. Orders were 15.5% higher than the third quarter of 2019 driving a record backlog of $1.85 billion.
